headlines: Gold: a bullish daily CRT — swept yesterday's low, closed back inside
Bitcoin took both sides of the Asian range
Ethereum took both sides of the Asian range

markets.name: Gold
markets.story: Gold rose 0.39% on a $38.3 range (57% of its 20-day average). The Asian high went first, at 00:21 New York in Asia, and the low followed at 15:03. Yesterday's low was taken at 21:05 the evening before. It swept yesterday's low and closed back inside — a bullish daily CRT. The busiest hour was 15:00 New York ($31.9).
markets.headline: Gold: a bullish daily CRT — swept yesterday's low, closed back inside
